headline: A 2018 law renames the Postal Service building at 915 Center Avenue in Payette, Idaho, as the Harmon Killebrew Post Office Building.
what_it_does: This law gives a name to a U.S. Postal Service facility in Payette, Idaho. The building's street address is 915 Center Avenue. It is now officially called the Harmon Killebrew Post Office Building. The law does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018, and the naming took effect that day.
